1. (h13 dispatch) Markdown processing sits behind an interface. Which concrete implementation(s) execute at runtime, who constructs them, and which components hold the interface? Look at internal/markdown/ (markdown.go, parser/, renderer/, ast/). Find the parser interface and concrete parser/renderer implementations. Also check server/router/api/v1 or server/runner/memopayload for who invokes markdown parsing. Give: impl (type — path:line) — construction site (path:line) — holders (who holds/uses the interface, path:line).

2. (h14 field-grain) Each memo carries derived metadata computed from its CONTENT rather than set by the user (used for lists/previews) — e.g. property flags like hasLink, hasTaskList, hasCode, hasIncompleteTasks, plus tags/snippet. Where is it computed? Look at server/runner/memopayload/runner.go — there's likely a function like RebuildMemoPayload / getMemoPropertyFromContent that parses the markdown AST and extracts properties. Which operations trigger recomputation (CreateMemo, UpdateMemo — find callers in server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go)? What properties does the computation extract? Give: computation site (path:line); triggers (path:line for each); extracted properties (list with path:line).

3. (h15 field-grain) Memo visibility (who may view a memo: PUBLIC/PROTECTED/PRIVATE) is enforced in more than one server surface. List EVERY distinct enforcement site (at least three) with files and line numbers. Search server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go (GetMemo, ListMemos filters), server/router/rss/, server/router/fileserver/ (attachment access checks visibility of parent memo), server/router/mcp/, memo_attachment_service.go, and any filter building. Grep for "Visibility", "VISIBILITY_PUBLIC", "PROTECTED", "PRIVATE" in server/. Give: enforcement site — path:line, one per line.

Report each with exact path:line citations.

content.text:
All findings gathered. Here is the analysis.

## h13 — Markdown dispatch

The interface is `markdown.Service`, defined at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:30`.

**Concrete implementation**
- `service` struct (wraps `goldmark.Markdown`) — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:57`. This is the *only* runtime implementation of `markdown.Service`. It embeds goldmark and delegates AST parsing to `s.md.Parser().Parse` (`markdown.go:113`).

Sub-implementations plugged into goldmark (not implementers of `Service`, but the concrete parser/renderer pieces the service uses):
- `tagParser` (implements `goldmark/parser.InlineParser`) — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/tag.go:19`, constructed by `NewTagParser` at `parser/tag.go:22`, wired in via `TagExtension` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go:14` (registered `extensions/tag.go:20`).
- `mentionParser` — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/mention.go:19`, `NewMentionParser` at `parser/mention.go:22`, wired via `MentionExtension` in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/mention.go`.
- `MarkdownRenderer` (AST-to-markdown renderer) — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:14`, `NewMarkdownRenderer` at `renderer/markdown_renderer.go:19`; instantiated per-call inside `service.RenderMarkdown` (`markdown.go:238`) and `service.RenameTag`. Custom AST node kinds live in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/tag.go` and `.../ast/mention.go`.

**Construction site**
- `markdown.NewService(...)` — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:81`. Called once, in `NewAPIV1Service` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` (with `WithTagExtension()` + `WithMentionExtension()`). This single instance is shared everywhere.

**Holders of the interface**
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — field decl `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`, assigned `v1.go:56`.
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — field `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`, ctor `NewRunner` `runner.go:19`. `RebuildMemoPayload` also takes it as a param (`runner.go:74`).
- `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` — field `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, ctor `NewRSSService` `rss.go:58` (fed `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` at `/bench/repo/server/server.go:85`); uses `RenderHTML` at `rss.go:339`.

**Invocation sites (who calls the parser)**: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` → `markdownService.ExtractAll` (`runner.go:78`); `memo_service.go:108` (CreateMemo) and `:447` (UpdateMemo) call `RebuildMemoPayload`; `memo_mention_helpers.go:32` calls `ExtractAll`; `memo_service_webhooks.go:85` calls `GenerateSnippet`; `rss.go:339` calls `RenderHTML`.

## h14 — Derived content metadata

**Computation site**
- `RebuildMemoPayload` — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`. It calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(memo.Content)` (`runner.go:78`) and writes `memo.Payload.Tags` (`runner.go:83`) and `memo.Payload.Property` (`runner.go:84`).
- Actual AST extraction happens in `service.ExtractAll` — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:337` (single-pass `gast.Walk`).

**Triggers (recomputation)**
- `CreateMemo` → `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (inside func starting `memo_service.go:70`).
- `UpdateMemo` → `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (inside func starting `memo_service.go:401`).
- Batch backfill: `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` → `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52`.

**Extracted properties** (all in `service.ExtractAll`, `markdown.go`; identical logic mirrored in `ExtractProperties` at `markdown.go:191`):
- `Tags` (`#tag` AST nodes, deduped) — `markdown.go:354` (collection), `runner.go:83` (stored).
- `Property.Title` (text of a leading H1) — `markdown.go:366`.
- `Property.HasLink` — `markdown.go:373`.
- `Property.HasCode` (code block / fenced / inline span) — `markdown.go:376`.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — `markdown.go:379`.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` (unchecked task checkbox) — `markdown.go:382`.
- Also collected: `Mentions` (`markdown.go:357`) — used by mention helpers, not stored in Payload.
- `snippet`: computed separately via `GenerateSnippet` (`markdown.go:264`), invoked only at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:85` (not part of `RebuildMemoPayload`).

## h15 — Visibility enforcement sites

- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:55` — `checkMemoReadAccess` core gate (GetMemo/comments), with the PRIVATE creator check at `memo_service.go:63`.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219` and `:222`/`:225` — ListMemos filter building (anonymous → PUBLIC only; authed → `creator_id == N || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]`).
- `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677` and `:699` — attachment blob access checks parent memo visibility (public+anonymous shortcut; PRIVATE non-owner/non-admin forbidden).
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445` and `:451` — attachment service read gate.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214` and `:222` — memo-attachment listing gate.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30`, `:38`, `:83` — reaction access gated on parent memo visibility.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141` — RSS feeds restricted to `store.Public`.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150` — frontend/sitemap restricted to `store.Public`.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:184`/`:186`, `memo_relation_service.go:109`/`:111`, `user_service_stats.go:84`/`:87`/`:90`/`:218`/`:220` — additional CEL/list filter builders applying the same PUBLIC / PUBLIC+PROTECTED rules.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:135` — SSE event fan-out gated by visibility (`canReceive`).

Note on MCP: `server/router/mcp/` has no independent visibility logic. Its catalog whitelists `MemoService_ListMemos` / `MemoService_GetMemo` (`/bench/repo/server/router/mcp/catalog.go:12`,`:14`) and delegates to the v1 `MemoService`, so it inherits the `memo_service.go` enforcement above.

The three-or-more distinct enforcement surfaces requested: v1 MemoService (`memo_service.go:55`,`:219`), fileserver blob access (`fileserver.go:677`/`:699`), attachment services (`attachment_service.go:445`, `memo_attachment_service.go:214`), and RSS (`rss.go:90`/`:141`).
